newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends firmer in slight correction.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends firmer in slight correction.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed slightly firmer on Wednesday after a mild correction to Tuesday's sharp losses.
The June contract closed $1.00 a tonne up at $173.00.
July Brent crude was trading six cents higher at $19.28 by 1643 GMT, towards the middle of the day's narrow trading range.
"It's fairly steady, there isn't much action...We're just waiting for the APIs to come out," a broker said.
Weekly stocks data from the American Petroleum Institute (API) were due out after the close of business on Wednesday.
Traders were expecting builds in crudes and distillates, while gasoline stocks and refinery utilisation were seen little changed from last week.
